generic.description: Sets HKCU\Software\Microsoft\Windows\CurrentVersion\Run registry key for autostart on user login.
Allocates RWX memory in explorer.exe (PID 1234) and writes shellcode via WriteProcessMemory, then triggers via CreateRemoteThread.
Queries system uptime via GetTickCount before executing payload — likely sandbox timing check.
Initializes CryptAcquireContext with PROV_RSA_AES, suggesting encrypted C2 communication or payload decryption.
